arguments.content:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx')
print("=== DataFrame ===")
print(df.to_string())
print("\n=== dtypes ===")
print(df.dtypes)

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
print("Entries:", z.namelist())

ns = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}

# Shared strings
shared = []
try:
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
    for si in root.findall('m:si', ns):
        text = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
        shared.append(text)
except KeyError:
    print("No sharedStrings.xml")

print("Shared strings:", shared)

# Sheet 1
root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
for row in root.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}row'):
    cells = []
    for c in row:
        ref = c.get('r')
        t = c.get('t')
        v = c.find('m:v', ns)
        val = v.text if v is not None else None
        if t == 's' and val is not None:
            val = shared[int(val)]
        cells.append(f"{ref}={val}")
    print("ROW:", cells)
